appDescription: Gachita keeps a family's car conversation as a trip record. It turns requests into navigation stops and collects to-do items for places the family is driving to.

function.name: GACHITA_ARRIVAL_TASKS
function.description: Show the to-do items that the family mentioned during the drive for the places they are going to, and read them out. Use this when the user asks what they need to do after arriving.

function.name: GACHITA_PAUSE_RECORDING
function.description: Pause recording the family's conversation in the car. Consent stays on and nothing is deleted. Use this when the user asks to stop or pause the trip recording.

function.name: GACHITA_RESUME_RECORDING
function.description: Resume recording the family's conversation in the car after it was paused. Use this when the user asks to continue or restart the trip recording.
